bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story is tight end Colston Loveland's injury status after Thanksgiving, as Loveland hurt his knee against the Detroit Lions on Thanksgiving Day, though the injury may not be as serious as initially thought, with the team later announcing he is "week to week" rather than heading to IR . The news comes as the Bears continue to ride high after their win, with Chicago securing a victory over Detroit on Thanksgiving to push into first place in the NFC North and the No.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions' Thanksgiving Day defense fell apart in a 39-35 loss to the Chicago Bears , with analysts noting the team's defense had handled injuries well so far this season, but it finally caught up to them on Thanksgiving . Despite the defeat, running back Jahmyr Gibbs had a historic performance, highlighted by a standout outing that included a long touchdown dash, while the Lions now look to regroup and clean up "self-inflicted wounds" after the loss to the Bears .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers fell to the Los Angeles Rams 26-13 in a Thanksgiving Eve matchup, dropping to 6-5 and intensifying concerns about their playoff chances as while Micah Parsons did return and played well, the offensive woes, particularly on the offensive line and in the running game, proved too much to overcome, leaving the Packers on the outside looking in on the playoff picture . Adding to the bad news, wide receiver Matthew Golden left the game with an ankle injury , joining Christian Watson in question marks for Week 13 as Green Bay deals with mounting injuries on offense.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings enter Sunday's Week 12 home game against the Atlanta Falcons banged up, having ruled out left tackle Christian Darrisaw, receiver Jordan Addison, and cornerback Isaiah Rodgers, while safety Harrison Smith is listed as questionable due to a quadriceps injury he suffered last week vs. the 49ers .
